sources.document_title: High Diode SMAJ series transient voltage suppressor diodes (SMAG plastic-encapsulate)
sources.locator: Page 1 features/absolute-maximum table (PPPM 400 W at 10/1000 us, IFSM 40 A, TJ -55 to +150 C, 'Polarity: Color band denotes cathode end') and page 2 electrical characteristics table, exact SMAJ15A row
sources.evidence_extract: Official High Diode SMAJ-series PDF served from the manufacturer domain h-diode.com; the LCSC datasheet host mirrors the same family document (alternate URL). Page 2 electrical table, exact SMAJ15A row (columns Part/Part(C)/VBR min/VBR max/IT/IR/VWM/IPP/VC): VBR 16.7 to 18.5 V at IT 1.0 mA, IR 5.0 uA max at VWM, VWM (reverse standoff) 15.0 V, IPP 16.4 A, VC 24.4 V max on the 10/1000 us waveform. Page 1: PPPM 400 W at 10/1000 us, IFSM 40 A (8.3 ms single half sine, unidirectional only), TJ/TSTG -55 to +150 C, polarity color band denotes cathode end. SHA-256 equals the copy independently recorded by the zudo-led-lamp SMAJ20A owner bundle on 2026-08-02, cross-validating document integrity.
